analyses.recommendation: Visually confirm the junction at the RD_INJ_OVER / RD_INJ_OVER_B crossing (centroid vicinity: 46.69904, 24.7). If a real overshoot is visible, trim the endpoint of RD_INJ_OVER to the exact intersection with RD_INJ_OVER_B. If the continuation is intentional (e.g., a fork, parallel lane, or overpass/underpass representation), mark this candidate as a false positive and document the justification.
